text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: However many times you try, you're not going to defeat us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何回出てきても、
私たちを止めるなんて不可能よ？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Mitsuki is quite correct...
We'll reduce your worthless body to a giant pile of scrap. Teehee.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミツキさんの言う通りです……
その無駄に大きな身体、
今すぐ壊してあげますわ……
クスクス。

text_block_list.name: Stechpalm
text_block_list.text:
No amount of power will sway us from our path!
All who attempt to stand in our way are doomed to fail!
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴様がどれだけ強くなろうとも結末は同じだ！
我々の前に立ちふさがるものは、
全て振り払ってみせる！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text:
Woohoooo! You're the coolest, Annie-girl!
Your burning spirit's almost setting me on fire!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うひょーう！　
アンナたそカッコいい！！
アタシいま体温何度あるのかなーッ！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Well said, Anna. Your words ring true!
Come at us, foe... and fall by my blade!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい啖呵だねアンナ、
アタシの心に響いたよ！
さあ来な……
叩き斬ってやる！
